evidence.claim: The company reports serving over 1 million customers with more than 100 million products sold globally, according to the official NewAge Fire Protection homepage.

A product demonstration of NewAge Fire Protection's LUF Robots and Mist Hoses was conducted for the Goa Emergency and Fire Services at Paradeep Phosphates in Zuarinagar, Goa, as published in a company update.

Installed Base & Service Network.assessed_on: The assessment rests on the company's verified delivery of localized technical demonstrations to emergency departments and self-reported broad global sales metrics. Based on primary research, the company has not disclosed audited breakdowns of its active critical infrastructure system maintenance contracts, localized support response times, or standard customer satisfaction metrics.
